title: The main bank's minimum (home.main.min) must be in the main bank's currency; a minimum in another currency is asked about (AS11)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 in pesos: the peso bank, the main bank, holds 50,000.00. The minimum saved with the main bank is 20,000 yen (kept from when a yen bank was the main bank). The app cannot turn yen into pesos (F11), so it asks the person for the minimum again. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The main bank's minimum is in yen and the main bank is in pesos: it is asked about, never converted [AS11, F11].
